title: MotorSearch
description:
`hpr motors search`: motor.fusionspace.co's motors that pass the filters, with their stock and
prices.

attribution.description:
The credits, shown with every list: motor.fusionspace.co's, as its terms ask, with their
caution to check stock and price on the vendor's own page; then ThrustCurve.org's, whose
figures the site repeats.

generated_at.description: When motor.fusionspace.co built the list, ISO 8601 UTC as the site writes it.

motors.description:
The motors that pass the filters, cheapest first: by one motor's price at the cheapest
vendor with it in stock, then by maker and designation. Motors with no such price in U.S.
dollars come last, by maker and designation.

read_from.description: Where the list was read from.

FoundMotor.description:
One motor that passed `hpr motors search`'s filters, as motor.fusionspace.co lists it. The
figures are ThrustCurve.org's published ones, which the site repeats.

cheapest_in_stock.description: The vendor with it in stock at the lowest price of one motor; `None` when out of stock.

common_name.description: The designation without its propellant code, such as `L851`.

delays.description: The delays it comes with, s, comma-separated, or `P` for plugged.

designation.description: The designation, as ThrustCurve.org spells it, such as `3683L851-P`.

in_stock.description: In stock at one vendor or more.

in_stock_vendor_count.description: How many vendors have it in stock.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer, as the site names it, such as `Cesaroni Technology`.

propellant.description: The propellant's trade name, such as `White Lightning`.

FoundOffer.description: A vendor's offer of a motor in stock, as motor.fusionspace.co lists it.

pack_size.description: How many motors the pack holds.

price_cents.description: The price of the pack, in hundredths of the currency, when the page shows one.

unit_price_cents.description: The price of one motor, in hundredths of the currency (cents), when the page shows one.

url.description: The product page, where stock and price are the vendor's to say.

MotorKind.description: Whether a motor is used once or reloaded into a reusable case.

oneOf.description: A reload for a reusable case.
A hybrid: listed, but hpr models solid motors only.

ReadFrom.description: Where a source's answer was read from.

oneOf.description: A file given on the command line: `--from`, or an ERA5 file.
Fetched now, and saved in the cache.

fetched_at_unix_s.description: When, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
When the copy was fetched, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

oneOf.description: The cache, older than the source keeps a copy fresh: offline, or the fetch failed.

fetched_at_unix_s.description: When the copy was fetched, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

reason.description: Online, why the fetch failed or its answer was refused.
